summary: Manulife Financial Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 earnings results and a quarterly dividend announcement. The filing reports core earnings of $1.8 billion, core EPS of $1.06, and a quarterly dividend declaration. It discusses financial performance, strategic progress, and capital returns including share buybacks. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K earnings release. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special situation elements. The filing is an ordinary periodic report with no special-situation catalyst.
